mostWorthwhile.text: Following filtration with nutrient recovery was most worthwhile: it shows why glucose can enter the filtrate yet normally return to blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was clear but predictable, with less explanatory detail than the filtration sequence.

surprise.text: The distinction between filtering glucose and then recovering almost all of it was the most useful change in understanding.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the named organ slots and the filtration-to-drainage sequence made their roles clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the construction sequence connected familiar biology to kidney function, although the organ fittings were less engaging.
